description: Update a manual journal in Xero. Only works on draft manual journals.  Do not modify line items or parameters that have not been specified by the user.

lineAmountTypes.description: Optional line amount types (EXCLUSIVE, INCLUSIVE, NO_TAX), NO_TAX by default

manualJournalID.description: ID of the manual journal to update

manualJournalLines.description: The manualJournalLines element must contain at least two individual manualJournalLine sub-elements

accountCode.description: Account code for the journal line

description.description: Optional description for manual journal line

lineAmount.description: Total for manual journal line. Debits are positive, credits are negative value

taxType.description: Optional tax type for the manual journal line

narration.description: Description of manual journal being posted

showOnCashBasisReports.description: Optional boolean to show on cash basis reports, default is true

status.description: Optional status of the manual journal (DRAFT, POSTED, DELETED, VOIDED, ARCHIVED), DRAFT by default

url.description: Optional URL link to a source document

name: update-manual-journal
